goal: Maintain a canonical inventory of GitHub failure incidents from mailbox observations, track recurrence and lifecycle through resolution or sandbox-required outcomes, identify cross-repository propagation candidates, and emit resolution-qualified mailbox archive plans.
required_next: bind to existing sovereign Healer scheduler
backfill current unread GitHub failure corpus
connect canonical worker and sandbox lifecycle outcomes
produce failure frequency, recurrence, amplification and cross-repository propagation metrics
terminal_when: live incremental failure ingestion operates through admitted TV/TVC transport
existing unread GitHub failure corpus is inventoried without losing source evidence
duplicate notifications map deterministically to canonical incidents
worker unable/impossible-to-repair outcomes produce SANDBOX_REQUIRED incident state
resolved incidents require durable evidence and emit bounded archive plans
systemic correlation metrics are durable and reproducible
no second scheduler, heartbeat, GitHub-token runtime authority or NON-TV/TVC secret/token is introduced
